newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ITC gains three percent on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India's ITC gains three percent on BSE.

text.p: Shares of tobacco firm ITC Ltd jumped 13.75 rupees, or three percent, to 450.25 in early trade on the Bombay bourse on Monday, traders said.
They said speculators were covering their short positions after a leading U.S. fund turned buyer in the stock late last week.
ITC said recently its net profit climbed to 3.43 billion rupees in the financial year ended March 31, 1997, from 2.6 billion in the previous year. The results were slightly above market expectations.
ITC shares attracted a backwardation charge -- which indicates a short position -- in the carry forward account ended May 31.
ITC shares were trading 5.80 rupees higher at 450.30 on the National bourse.
